skill.description: Frontend development skill for React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS workflows. It includes reference guidance and simple Python scripts for component scaffolding, bundle analysis, and frontend project review.

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and inline file paths, not executable shell calls. The only confirmed findings are the three Python scripts that can overwrite caller-supplied output paths without checks. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Unrestricted report output paths in Python scripts
remediation.suggestion: Add overwrite confirmation, normalize the output path, and restrict writes to the project or a documented reports directory.

content.value_statement: Frontend work needs consistent React, Next.js, and performance decisions. This skill provides scripts and reference guidance for scaffolding, analysis, and reviews.
actual_capabilities: Documents React patterns, Next.js optimization, and frontend best practices.
Provides Python scripts for component generation, bundle analysis, and frontend scaffolding.
Validates that a target path exists before script analysis runs.
Prints simple status and finding counts for a target path.
Writes JSON results to an explicit output file when requested.
Includes command examples for development, analysis, and deployment workflows.
limitations: The scripts are minimal templates and do not perform deep bundle inspection.
Generated reports contain status, target path, and empty findings unless extended.
The skill does not install dependencies or run external services automatically.
Output file paths are caller supplied and should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Plan a React Feature
use_cases.description: Use the references to choose component structure, state boundaries, and review criteria before implementation.

use_cases.title: Standardize Frontend Reviews
use_cases.description: Use the best practice sections to check code quality, performance, security, and maintainability during reviews.

use_cases.title: Prepare Project Analysis
use_cases.description: Run the included scripts against a target path to produce simple status output for follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Component Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new UI component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-frontend skill to review this component idea. Identify the component boundaries, state needs, accessibility concerns, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Frontend Scaffold
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a feature area.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the component generator guidance to plan a scaffold for this feature. Include file responsibilities, naming, styling, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Performance Risks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a Next.js route or page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Next.js optimization guidance to inspect this page. Find rendering, bundle, caching, data loading, and image optimization risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced modernization of an existing frontend.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use all senior-frontend references to design a migration plan. Cover architecture, dependency risk, rollout order, quality gates, and monitoring.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed React dashboard component before implementation.
output_examples.output: A structured review covering component boundaries, state ownership, accessibility checks, performance risks, and recommended tests.

output_examples.input: Analyze a Next.js page that feels slow during navigation.
output_examples.output: A performance review that prioritizes rendering mode, data loading, bundle size, image handling, and caching improvements.

output_examples.input: Prepare frontend review guidance for a pull request.
output_examples.output: A concise checklist for code organization, security, maintainability, testing, and production readiness.

best_practices: Review generated script commands before running them on a project.
Use the references as review criteria, then verify changes with project tests.
Keep output files inside the project or a dedicated reports directory.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the placeholder scripts as complete production analyzers.
Do not run deployment commands from examples without environment review.
Do not write report output over existing project files.

faq.question: What frontend stacks does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and common frontend review workflows.

faq.question: Does it generate production-ready components automatically?
faq.answer: No. The scripts are simple templates and should be extended before production use.

faq.question: Can it help with performance reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides Next.js and frontend performance guidance for reviews and planning.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and includes scripts that users or agents must choose to run.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I check before using the output option?
faq.answer: Confirm the output path is safe and does not overwrite important project files.
